mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND tm.transport_category IN
#{category}
AND tm.lap_time IS NOT NULL
AND tm.top_speed IS NOT NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT tm.model_id ,tm.manufacturer ,tm.price ,tm.name ,tm.transport_category ,tm.lap_time ,tm.top_speed ,tm.features ,ot.owned_id ,ot.image_url FROM transport_model tm LEFT JOIN owned_transport ot ON ot.owned_id = ( SELECT MIN(ot2.owned_id) FROM owned_transport ot2 WHERE ot2.model_id = tm.model_id AND ot2.user_id = #{userId} AND ot2.acquired_yn = 'Y' )
ORDER BY tm.lap_time ASC, tm.top_speed DESC, tm.price DESC, tm.name ASC, tm.model_id ASC
ORDER BY tm.top_speed DESC, tm.lap_time ASC, tm.price DESC, tm.name ASC, tm.model_id ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT ranked.model_id, ranked.manufacturer, ranked.price, ranked.name, ranked.transport_category, ranked.lap_time, ranked.top_speed, ranked.features, ot.owned_id, ot.image_url, ranked.display_rank AS `rank`
FROM ( SELECT remaining.model_id, remaining.manufacturer, remaining.price, remaining.name, remaining.transport_category, remaining.lap_time, remaining.top_speed, remaining.features, remaining.row_no,
3 + RANK() OVER (
ORDER BY remaining.lap_time ASC
ORDER BY remaining.top_speed DESC
) AS display_rank
FROM ( SELECT tm.model_id, tm.manufacturer, tm.price, tm.name, tm.transport_category, tm.lap_time, tm.top_speed, tm.features,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
ORDER BY tm.lap_time ASC, tm.top_speed DESC, tm.price DESC, tm.name ASC, tm.model_id ASC
ORDER BY tm.top_speed DESC, tm.lap_time ASC, tm.price DESC, tm.name ASC, tm.model_id ASC
) AS row_no
FROM transport_model tm
) remaining
WHERE remaining.row_no > 3
) ranked
LEFT JOIN owned_transport ot ON ot.owned_id = ( SELECT MIN(ot2.owned_id) FROM owned_transport ot2 WHERE ot2.model_id = ranked.model_id AND ot2.user_id = #{userId} AND ot2.acquired_yn = 'Y' )
ORDER BY ranked.row_no ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
